observed_endpoints.full_lloyd_rejected_reason: Positive overall effect but negative means in some source, split, script, and language groups versus the current int7 candidate.

selection_rule: Select the largest positive overall ground-truth gain whose source, split, script, and language mean deltas are all nonnegative for ground-truth, edge, and teacher metrics. If no blend passes, retain max-range int7 unchanged.
artifact_rule: Every selected dense state must remain exactly recoverable as signed int7 codes plus one FP16 scale per output before browser artifact work.
